summary.text: Shaunie Cousins is the Republican candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 34, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Mari Watanabe (D).
Ballotpedia lists her profession as consultant, and in a Ballotpedia survey she described a background in human services, health care policy and regulatory work.

paragraphs.text: Shaunie Cousins graduated from Spring Creek High School.
In her Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mother of eight in a blended family and a military wife.
She advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
She listed fiscal accountability, affordability, public safety and education as her main policy areas, including parental involvement in schools.
